tooltip.underdeep.ancient_seed: A seed sealed in stone for ages.
tooltip.underdeep.antidote_tincture: Cures poison and other harmful effects.
tooltip.underdeep.bandage: Binds a wound: stops it slowing your recovery
tooltip.underdeep.bedroll: Rest on expeditions. Does not move your respawn point unless you sneak while lying down.
tooltip.underdeep.berry_juice: Juice: a quick spring in your step
tooltip.underdeep.bloodcap: A blood-red fungus of the crimson basins. Toxic.
tooltip.underdeep.bloodcap_tonic: Three minutes of extra health (long cooldown)
tooltip.underdeep.bloodthorn_sapling: Twisted heat-loving tree. Grows on volcanic ground; fireproof wood.
tooltip.underdeep.bogbloom: Marsh flower. Blooms when water is close.
tooltip.underdeep.bogwort: Medicinal marsh herb. Needs water right beside it to grow.
tooltip.underdeep.bracket_fungus: Shelf fungus that grows on the sides of logs and rotting wood.
tooltip.underdeep.briar_fruit: Filling, but thorny bushes guard it. Occasionally mildly toxic.
tooltip.underdeep.budding_glimmer:
Grows glimmer crystals on its open faces in darkness.
Silk touch moves it.
tooltip.underdeep.calcicap: Chalky mineral fungus of stony ground. Grinds into bone meal.
tooltip.underdeep.calming_balm: Soothes dizziness and clears the eyes
tooltip.underdeep.camp_awning: Shelter: standing near it protects you a little from cold and heat, and makes rest more comfortable.
tooltip.underdeep.cave_truffle: Grows in darkness on farmland or soil. Better roasted.
tooltip.underdeep.cinderbark_sapling: Gnarled volcanic tree. Only grows on volcanic ground near heat.
tooltip.underdeep.cinnabar: A red mineral. Ground into dye; valued by alchemists.
tooltip.underdeep.clay_oven: Breads, pies and roasts. Burns fuel.
tooltip.underdeep.compost: Fertiliser: use on crops, herbs and bushes; makes rich soil
tooltip.underdeep.compost_bin: Turns plant and food scraps into compost.
tooltip.underdeep.cooking_pot: Soups and stews. Needs a fire, campfire or lava below. Cooks up to 4 servings at once.
tooltip.underdeep.cragpine_sapling: Wind-bent mountain tree. Grows on stony ground.
tooltip.underdeep.creature_egg: Can stand in for a bird's egg.
tooltip.underdeep.cryolite: Always cold to the touch. Freezes water.
tooltip.underdeep.drying_rack: Hang meat, fish, fruit, fungi or hides to dry. Right-click to hang, again to take.
tooltip.underdeep.duskberries: Edible. Plant them to grow a duskberry bush.
tooltip.underdeep.duskoak_sapling: Broad branching forest tree. Grows from saplings on living soil.
tooltip.underdeep.duskroot: A staple root. Better baked. Plant on farmland.
tooltip.underdeep.embercap: Glowing volcanic fungus. Only spreads near heat.
tooltip.underdeep.emberite: Burns for a very long time.
tooltip.underdeep.emberpepper: Fiery. Grows much faster near heat.
tooltip.underdeep.emberwort: Heat-loving medicinal herb. Grows faster near lava or fire.
tooltip.underdeep.emberwort_root: A medicinal root that holds heat.
tooltip.underdeep.emberwort_tonic: Protects from fire and lava for a while.
tooltip.underdeep.feeding_trough: Fill with animal feed: tamed animals nearby eat when hungry and stay productive.
tooltip.underdeep.fermentation_crock: Pickles, cheese, vinegar and fermented drinks. Slow, needs no heat.
tooltip.underdeep.field_medkit: Complete field treatment: wounds and poison
tooltip.underdeep.fish_trap: Place in water with bait inside. Catches what lives in these waters, slowly.
tooltip.underdeep.fishing_bait: Hold in your other hand while fishing, or put in a fish trap
tooltip.underdeep.fortifying_elixir: Brief resistance before a dangerous fight (long cooldown)
tooltip.underdeep.fossil_fragment: Ancient bone. Grinds into bone meal.
tooltip.underdeep.frost_turnip: Hardy and slow. Grows only in the cold, away from heat.
tooltip.underdeep.frostbell: Frozen bell flower. Blooms only in the cold, away from heat.
tooltip.underdeep.frostfir_sapling: Cold-adapted conifer. Grows on snow and ice; dormant near heat.
tooltip.underdeep.fur_tuft: Four make a block of wool.
tooltip.underdeep.galvanite: A conductive mineral that hums faintly.
tooltip.underdeep.ghostfern: A pale translucent fern of dark places.
tooltip.underdeep.glimmerfin: A shimmering fish of the luminous waters. Cook it.
tooltip.underdeep.gloomcap: Faintly glowing fungus that grows only in darkness.
tooltip.underdeep.glowfern:
A softly glowing forest fern.
Spreads slowly in dim light.
tooltip.underdeep.glowivy: Glowing climbing ivy. Grows on walls and ceilings.
tooltip.underdeep.glowkelp: Luminous kelp that forms underwater forests.
tooltip.underdeep.glowpad: Glowing floating pad. Slowly spreads across still water.
tooltip.underdeep.goldgrass: Golden meadow grass. Its seed heads sometimes hold wild glowgrain.
tooltip.underdeep.goldwood_sapling: Golden broad-crowned tree. Needs bright light to grow.
tooltip.underdeep.grain_feed: Feed for grazing and browsing animals
tooltip.underdeep.grounding_paste: Protects from static charge for 10 minutes
tooltip.underdeep.hardtack: Preserved travel bread: very filling for its size
tooltip.underdeep.harness: Lets you ride a trusting mount.
tooltip.underdeep.herbalist_table: Medicine, salves, tinctures and herb cuttings.
tooltip.underdeep.hide: Tans into leather in a furnace.
tooltip.underdeep.honeyfruit: Sweet and restorative. Plant it to grow a bush.
tooltip.underdeep.jasper: A banded stone from fossil forests.
tooltip.underdeep.kettle: Teas, broths and infusions. Needs heat below.
tooltip.underdeep.kitchen_counter: 9 slots of storage. Counts as a kitchen for a comfortable home.
tooltip.underdeep.lake_chestnut: Plant it on a lake bed. Better roasted.
tooltip.underdeep.lanterncap:
Glowing fungal colonies that bloom and fade.
Placed caps keep glowing.
tooltip.underdeep.ledgevine: Leafy vine hanging from mountain ledges.
tooltip.underdeep.lumenwood_sapling: Luminous umbrella tree with glowing foliage.
tooltip.underdeep.malachite: A copper mineral. Smelts into copper.
tooltip.underdeep.marsh_fern: Dense wetland fern. Wild mire rice hides among it.
tooltip.underdeep.mendleaf:
Medicinal herb of forest floors.
Pick the leaves once it is full grown.
tooltip.underdeep.mire_eel: A slippery wetland eel. Cook it.
tooltip.underdeep.mire_rice: Needs water right beside it to grow.
tooltip.underdeep.mirewillow_sapling: Weeping wetland tree. Grows on mud, clay and wet soil.
tooltip.underdeep.moonpetal: A rare silver herb. Needs bright light.
tooltip.underdeep.moonpetal_draught: Lets you see in the dark for a while.
tooltip.underdeep.moonpetal_petal: Said to sharpen the eyes in darkness.
tooltip.underdeep.niter: Forms where organic matter decays. An ingredient of gunpowder.
tooltip.underdeep.pantry: Food storage: 27 slots for food, drinks and ingredients.
tooltip.underdeep.peakstar: A small mountain star flower. Opens in bright light.
tooltip.underdeep.petrolichen: A mineral-eating crust that grows on stone and petrified wood.
tooltip.underdeep.planter_box: A rich-soil planter for herbs, flowers, fungi and crops indoors.
tooltip.underdeep.preparation_table: Grinding, mixing, salads, rations, juices and animal feed.
tooltip.underdeep.prism_lily: A translucent crystal flower that opens in darkness.
tooltip.underdeep.purging_draught: Purges every ailment, but leaves you queasy (very long cooldown)
tooltip.underdeep.pyrelily: A volcanic lily. Opens and glows only near heat.
tooltip.underdeep.raw_starsilver: A bright metal from starlit caverns.
tooltip.underdeep.raw_umbralite: A rare metal of the deep dark.
tooltip.underdeep.reef_darter: A quick fish of the drowned gardens. Cook it.
tooltip.underdeep.resin_knot: Slowly fills with amber resin. Collect it when it glows.
tooltip.underdeep.restorative_tonic: Recovery and an end to weariness
tooltip.underdeep.ribbonweed: Long underwater ribbons. Fish shelter in them.
tooltip.underdeep.rich_soil: Crops grow faster on it and it never dries out. Plant crops, herbs or bushes.
tooltip.underdeep.rotting_log: Decaying wood. Fungi sprout from it over time.
tooltip.underdeep.sagecap: A rare grey-green fungus valued by healers.
tooltip.underdeep.shardgrass: Brittle crystalline grass that grows on mineral ground.
tooltip.underdeep.siltwort: A rare submerged medicinal herb of lake beds.
tooltip.underdeep.silvergrass: Luminous silver grass. Its seed heads sometimes hold wild glowgrain.
tooltip.underdeep.snapjaw:
Snaps at anything that steps into it. Sneak past carefully.
Shears collect the whole plant.
tooltip.underdeep.snapjaw_fang: A fang from a predatory plant.
tooltip.underdeep.snowberries: Edible. Bushes only grow in the cold.
tooltip.underdeep.spirebark_sapling: Very tall narrow tree. Tolerates stony ground.
tooltip.underdeep.sporepuff:
Bursts into a spore cloud when touched.
The spores seed new fungi.
tooltip.underdeep.starlily: A floating star flower of starlit lakes.
tooltip.underdeep.starstrand: Glowing strands hanging from starlit ceilings.
tooltip.underdeep.static_grass: Crackling blue grass of the stormstone caverns.
tooltip.underdeep.steamfern: A fern that only spreads near warmth in frozen caverns.
tooltip.underdeep.storm_lichen: A crackling lichen that feeds on charged stone.
tooltip.underdeep.sulfur: Volcanic mineral. An ingredient of gunpowder.
tooltip.underdeep.sunbean: Upsets the stomach raw; cook in a stew. Needs bright light.
tooltip.underdeep.sunleaf: A rare sun-coloured herb. Needs bright light.
tooltip.underdeep.sunleaf_salve: Hardens the body against harm for a while.
tooltip.underdeep.supply_crate: 18 slots of storage. Keeps its contents when broken.
tooltip.underdeep.tidecap: A glowing fungus that grows underwater.
tooltip.underdeep.travel_ration: Expedition ration: compact and very filling
tooltip.underdeep.umbral_bloom: A flower of the deepest darkness.
tooltip.underdeep.umbral_petal: A strange petal. Its uses are unknown.
tooltip.underdeep.vigor_draught: A minute of speed and haste (long cooldown)
tooltip.underdeep.voidroot: Black roots hanging in the deep dark. Their fibres are tough.
tooltip.underdeep.voidroot_fiber: Tough fibre. Three twist into string.
tooltip.underdeep.voltbloom: A mineral flower that blazes when energy flows nearby.
tooltip.underdeep.wooden_table: Furniture. Counts toward a comfortable home.
